text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
...It's Cheval Grand, Cheval Grand!
In the lead is Cheval Grand—and she crosses the line!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Clear skies ahead for the Spring Tenno Sho!
Cheval Grand takes a splendid victory!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah..., did I... win...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: M-Me...? Truly—

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: ...That's right, Cheval-chan.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
You're 1st place.
...Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Shine...

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, it's so frustrating!
I thought I gave it everything, every last bit.
Yet I couldn't even get close to Cheval-chan's back.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
It's frustrating... it really is.
Still, let me properly congratulate you.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Cheval-chan.
You were—strong out there. Truly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that... Cheval Grand appeared in the winner's circle—a place reserved only for the victor—and—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan Angler
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Cheval Grand!!
You sure put on one hell of a showーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOO!!
Congrats on 1st place, Cheval!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if truly savoring
the loud cheers resounding from the fans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I bowed my head deeply and slowly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, with the Winning Live concluded,
we were in the waiting room getting ready to head home when—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Cheva-chi~!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You were sooooo amazing!!
You looked sooooo cool, Cheval-chi~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: W-Wah, huh... V-Vivlos—?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on 1st place, Cheval.
...That was a magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Even Big sis...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Listen, listen! I sent photos to Mom and Dad too!
And I told them all about the race!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Cheva-chi won across a waaaay longer
distance than I could ever run, like,
can you believe it?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Full of stamina,
zooming all the way to the very end!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you,
she was really, truly, sooo strong!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...N-No...
You're exaggerating—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: It's not an exaggeration at all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...It's not an exaggeration at all, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
!
...Big sis...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...To tell the truth. When I learned you chose a completely different path from me—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I felt a little lonely... and worried.
...No, maybe I was just frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I can't put my experience to good use for you.
Even though I'm your big sister, I can't even be of help... I thought."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yet as you pushed forward—
you truly discovered your very own strength.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Walk a different path than mine.
Find a strength that is yours alone.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You've grown so admirable.
I am—so proud of you, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...
...Thank... you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After saying only that, Cheval Grand fell completely silent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos seemed worried, but urged on by
Verxina's gentle expression, the two of them
left the waiting room...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Cheval Grand, whose response
was still somewhat vague, I left the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, as I left Hanshin Racecourse
with a quieter-than-usual girl
and headed towards the inn—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I-It's no good.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer.
I... I—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Excuse me for just a second...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand broke into a run.
Her steps were somewhat unsteady,
yet she never once stopped.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, running, and running—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running and running, at the beach where she finally arrived...
...she was there.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Hah...
*grrrr*...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ...Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ngh, waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhhhh-----!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!
Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, ngh...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I've always... hated myself so much...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I can't be like my big sister,
nor can I be like my little sister.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm not exceptional.
Nor do I have any pride.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I don't have that kind of
boundless cheerfulness at all.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I hated myself more than anyone else in the whole world...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...But—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Still... argh...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Still, even I... managed to become it.
I can become strong!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Even I... Even I can...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand was trembling.
Not from fear. Nor from anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because I understood that so well.
Because I believe I understand it better than anyone else, I raise my voice.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ngh!!
Ah... Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ngh, —

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I will—!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Get strong!!
Get so, so much stronger!!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: To become the absolute... "greatest Umamusume" in the world!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Wh... Wh—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'll do iiit, just you waaaatch!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A powerful vow echoes across the nighttime sea.
The waves were watching. The moon was watching.
And above all, I was watching.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Frail yet standing tall with pride,
her figure was—unmistakable.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
*cough* *cough-cough*!!
*pant*, *wheeze*...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Kyuuu—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly catch Cheval Grand
as she collapses from oxygen deprivation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it lacked a bit of polish...
she showed undeniable growth. Together with her,
I will continue to move forward. From here on out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our next target is the Tenno Sho (Spring).
The decisive showdown against Kitasan Black awaits—
